content: Fair. I just worry there's no possibility of sufficient scaling to contribute at all into end-game using %base damage without having the scaling be a huge multiplier. With a relatively small % current damage multiplier, it can do relatively little at low levels and without building the team around it, but be a strong scaler for late-game if you build for it specifically. I have no idea what the numbers would have to be for that, but it could probably be narrowed down to something good without *too* much play-testing. At the very least, it should be much easier to balance than %HP in the current meta, where HP on enemies can go up by an order of magnitude with no warning lol.
